VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses launch in the U.S., featuring a 147-inch virtual screen and HDR10 Micro-OLED displays, making big-screen experiences more accessible.

VR.title: Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy Returns The Shooter To Its 2024 Era Later This Month
VR.summary: Combat Waffle Studios announces Ghosts of Tabor: Legacy, restoring the 2024 version of the shooter, set to release for Meta Quest and PC VR.

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple has released technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, expanding development opportunities.

VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirmed ongoing work on multiple next-generation headsets, hinting at a potential reveal during the upcoming Connect event.

VR.title: John Carmack Reminds Microsoft He'll Guarantee $1 Million To Bring Team Beef’s Ports To VR
VR.summary: John Carmack has reiterated his $1 million guarantee to support VR ports of classic id Software games, emphasizing their commercial potential.

VR.title: VR/MR Puzzler Squingle Arcade Is Out Today On Meta Quest For Free
VR.summary: Squingle Arcade, a fast-paced VR/MR puzzle game with hand tracking, is now available for free on Meta Quest.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging the theft of trade secrets to advance the AI startup's hardware initiatives.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: In response to backlash, Meta has disabled an Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes of public accounts.

AI.title: Apple’s failed self-driving car program left a legacy of powerful AI chips
AI.summary: Apple's failed self-driving car project has inadvertently led to the development of powerful AI chips, enhancing its technology portfolio.

AI.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
AI.summary: Sunrun is launching a pilot program to place AI data center compute units in customers' homes, offering incentives for participation.

AI.title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
AI.summary: OpenAI is shutting down ChatGPT Atlas, its browser tool, less than a year after its launch, as part of a broader restructuring.

AI.title: Fidji Simo steps down from leading OpenAI’s AGI work due to illness
AI.summary: Fidji Simo is stepping down as OpenAI's AGI chief due to health issues, transitioning to a part-time advisory role.

NFL.title: Niners part owner agrees to purchase Seahawks
NFL.summary: A group led by Vinod Khosla has agreed to purchase the Seahawks for a record $9.612 billion, requiring him to divest from the 49ers.

NFL.title: Study: NFLers die from dementia at higher rate
NFL.summary: A new study reveals NFL players are four times more likely to die from neurodegenerative diseases like dementia compared to the general population.

NFL.title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins
NFL.summary: The Washington Commanders will retire the No. 44 jersey in honor of Hall of Famer John Riggins, celebrating his legacy in the franchise.

NFL.title: Sources: CB Douglas to sign with Commanders
NFL.summary: Free agent cornerback Rasul Douglas is set to sign a one-year deal with the Washington Commanders worth up to $3.8 million.

NFL.title: Clutch Vinatieri to enter Colts' Ring of Honor
NFL.summary: Kicker Adam Vinatieri will enter the Colts' Ring of Honor during a ceremony on October 18, following his Hall of Fame induction.

NFL.title: Aaron Rodgers can become the fifth quarterback in NFL history with 70,000 passing yards
NFL.summary: Aaron Rodgers aims to become the fifth quarterback in NFL history to surpass 70,000 passing yards in what he claims will be his final season.
